lines: He indeed one not would be someone even in three worlds ever; by word-attachment knowledge thought indeed is called.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa hyeko na bhavetkaścit trijagatyāpi jātucit śabdārūṣaṇayā jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ kila kathyate
